title: Getting Started with Elementa UI on React
description: Complete setup guide for integrating Elementa UI into your React.js project

sections.title: Prerequisites
sections.content: Before installing Elementa UI, ensure you have the following:
items: npm, yarn, or pnpm package manager

sections.title: Step 1: Install Peer Dependencies
sections.content: Elementa UI requires several peer dependencies. Install them automatically or manually:

sections.title: Step 4: Update your root layout.tsx
sections.content: Update your root layout.tsx file to incorporate all styling changes:
sections.code:
import {ReactLenis} from 'lenis/react';

<html
	lang="en"
	className="bg-bg-base-primary antialiased"
	data-energy={energy} // This is what applies an energy to your UI
>
	<ReactLenis
		root
		options={{
			lerp: 0.1,
			duration: 1.5,
			smoothWheel: true,
			syncTouch: true
		}}}
		{children}
	</ReactLenis>
</html>

subsections.title: Check code for theme-switcher and energy-switcher
subsections.content: Check the code for theme-switcher and energy-switcher blocks. They use zustand as state library. You are free to choose any library of your liking, but the overall idea is same. Changing the theme and energy should update the UI colors accordingly.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.content: Great! You're now ready to use Elementa UI. Here's what to do next:
items: Explore the Component and Blocks Library to see all available components
Read the component and block documentation for detailed usage examples
Check out design philosophy to understand component patterns
Join our community for support and feature requests
Contribute components and blocks back to the library
Checkout the color mappings and usage guidelines

subsections.title: Styles not applying?
subsections.content: Make sure you've imported the global styles and configured Tailwind CSS paths correctly. Check the styling and semantic mappings match with elementa-ui GitHub repo. Clear your .next folder and rebuild.

subsections.title: Components not found?
subsections.content: Check that the latest components and blocks code is imported either via elementa website or GitHub repository @ https://github.com/deriva-inc/elementa-ui.

subsections.title: Dark mode not working?
subsections.content: Ensure @custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *)); is present in your globals.css file. Ensure that the dark mode semantics are present in your theme.css and all the relevant energy specific styling files.
